description: An empty verbatim constituent has empty strings and claims no uncovered text. At input start, its empty source is the first input token's source start, as for an ordinary empty constituent (engine §11.1, §12).

documents.g.md:
```jbogenbau
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text [{part}]
%rule part letter | space
%rule letter "a" | "b" %emits $ :: L

%rule space " "
```
documents.h.md:
```jbogenbau
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text ($e:gap $n:none L L) %emits $e :: E, $n :: N

%rule gap :- $.verbatim-text | ε

%rule none ε
```
